behavior: Combobox and Autocomplete name in `aria-activedescendant` the `id` that the element of the highlighted item has now. A `#render` slot can give that element another `id`, and the reference follows each change of it. While the element has an empty `id`, and while the highlighted item has no element, there is no `aria-activedescendant`. A virtualized list that does not render the highlighted item thus gives no `aria-activedescendant`. Base UI names the id of the root plus the index of the item. A `render` element of the item with another `id`, or a highlighted item that a virtualized list does not render, thus leaves an `aria-activedescendant` that names no element.
